description: P0 (Critical) Bug Detection Rules for Traveloka Flight Flows

rules.name: Page is Blank/Unreadable
rules.description: Main content area is completely empty or unreadable
checks: DOM has no meaningful content (less than 100 characters of text)
Page body is empty or contains only error messages
Main container has display:none or visibility:hidden

rules.name: Page Loading Timeout
rules.description: Page takes too long to load (exceeds 30 seconds)
checks: Page load time > 30000ms
Network requests stuck in pending state

rules.name: Search Form Not Functional
rules.description: Critical search form cannot be used to search
checks: Search button disabled or not clickable
Search button has opacity < 0.5 or pointer-events:none
Departure/Arrival airport input frozen
Date picker not responding to clicks
Form submission fails (button click has no effect)

rules.name: Booking Form Not Functional
rules.description: Critical booking form cannot be submitted
checks: Passenger name/email input disabled
Payment button disabled or not clickable
Seat selection form frozen
Form submission fails with no feedback

rules.name: Payment Gateway Unreachable
checks: Payment API endpoint returns 500-599 status
Payment processing timeout > 15 seconds
Payment error message: 'Service Unavailable'

rules.name: Passenger Data Lost or Corrupted
rules.description: User data disappears or shows garbage characters
checks: Selected seats reset to empty
Passenger name shows as: undefined, null, [object Object]
Price displays as NaN or negative values
Passenger data reloads shows different values than submitted

rules.name: Security Vulnerability Detected
rules.description: XSS, CSRF, SQL injection evidence found
checks: Page HTML contains unescaped user input in DOM
No CSRF token in forms
SQL error messages exposed in page
Authentication bypass detected (can access without login)
rules.impact: User accounts at risk of compromise

rules.name: Critical Action Button Not Working
checks: Button has pointer-events:none
Button has display:none or visibility:hidden
Button click event listener removed (no response)
Button shows loading spinner indefinitely (> 30 seconds)

rules.name: Critical Network Error
rules.description: Core API endpoint returns 503/502 or timeout
checks: Flight search API returns 502/503/504
Booking API returns 502/503/504
API timeout (no response after 30s)
CORS policy blocks API requests

rules.name: Currency Symbol Missing in Prices
rules.description: Prices show as numbers only (e.g., '12000' instead of 'Rp 12,000')
checks: Price displayed without currency symbol
No currency format detected for locale

rules.name: Session Expired During Transaction
checks: Auth token missing from requests
API returns 401 Unauthorized
User redirected to login mid-booking

severity_levels.P0: Complete feature outage or data loss. Affects revenue or security. Immediate action required.
severity_levels.P1: Feature severely degraded but workaround exists. Affects multiple users.
severity_levels.P2: Feature partially broken. Single user workaround available.
severity_levels.P3: Minor issue. User experience impacted slightly.
